note: CO2e factors come from US EPA WARM v16 (December 2023) and describe US recycling and landfill conditions, not Indian ones; treat the CO2e total as an estimate. Scrap rates are the median of public Delhi price lists read in August to October 2026; glass and e-waste rates were not found and are placeholders.

anchors.paper: WARM v16 Exhibit 1-1, Mixed Paper (primarily residential): net recycling (3.55) and net landfilling 0.02 MTCO2E per short ton. Avoided vs landfill = 3.57 x 1000 / 907.185 = 3.94 kg CO2e per kg.
anchors.plastic: WARM v16 Exhibit 1-1, Mixed Plastics: net recycling (0.93), landfilling 0.02. Avoided = 0.95 MTCO2E per short ton = 1.05 kg per kg.
anchors.metal: WARM v16 Exhibit 1-1, Mixed Metals: net recycling (4.39), landfilling 0.02. Avoided = 4.41 per short ton = 4.86 kg per kg (aluminium cans alone are (9.13), steel cans (1.83)).
anchors.ewaste: WARM v16 Exhibit 1-2, Mixed Electronics: net recycling (0.90), landfilling 0.02. Avoided = 0.92 per short ton = 1.01 kg per kg.
anchors.glass: WARM v16 Exhibit 1-2, Glass: net recycling (0.28), landfilling 0.02. Avoided = 0.30 per short ton = 0.33 kg per kg.

rateAnchors.paper: Newspaper Rs 10 to 15 per kg and cardboard Rs 6 to 15 per kg across the six Delhi price lists below; median of the listed values is about Rs 12.
rateAnchors.plastic: Mixed plastic Rs 8 to 15 per kg (13.64, 14.29, 14, 15, 8); median Rs 14.
rateAnchors.metal: Iron Rs 25 to 33 per kg (33.20, 26, 25, 28 to 34); median about Rs 28. Aluminium and copper are far higher and are not assumed.
rateAnchors.ewaste: No Delhi household e-waste rate found: Rs 15 is a placeholder.
rateAnchors.glass: No Delhi glass rate found: Rs 2 is a placeholder.

sources.title: US EPA WARM v16: Exhibit 1-1 and 1-2, net GHG emissions by material and management option (Dec 2023)
